priorityBlocks.label: Backend guards
priorityBlocks.evidence: Preview requires patient/request ownership, roles clinic/admin/doctor, RLS tests, and no service-role use from public flows before real backend activation.
priorityBlocks.liveGate: No real patient/request write is enabled from this static preview.

priorityBlocks.label: Licencia médica obligatoria
priorityBlocks.evidence: Doctor data includes license/RCP status and blocks pending/missing credentials from mission eligibility.
priorityBlocks.liveGate: A verified license + credential check is mandatory before any real mission.

priorityBlocks.label: Conformidad MX
priorityBlocks.evidence: UI copy limits scope: no AI diagnosis, no emergency handling, privacy/consent/logging required before pilot.
priorityBlocks.liveGate: Closed pilot only until aviso de privacidad, consent, logs and legal wording are validated.

priorityBlocks.label: Pagos
priorityBlocks.evidence: Payment flow is specified as authorization before dispatch, capture after completion, refunds/disputes controlled.
priorityBlocks.liveGate: No payment capture is connected in this preview. Test mode only before provider approval.

priorityBlocks.label: Ops IA dispatch
priorityBlocks.evidence: AI dispatch policy covers triage, eligibility, scoring, waves, monitoring and escalation SLA.
priorityBlocks.liveGate: AI only orchestrates operations; it does not diagnose. Human escalation remains safety backstop.

priorityBlocks.label: Piloto cerrado
priorityBlocks.evidence: Preview is limited to demo data, zones, 5–10 verified doctors and monitoring posture.
priorityBlocks.liveGate: No public promise or open launch until pilot scope is explicitly approved.

nextForRealProduction: Bind to real backend routes with RLS/ownership tests passing
Run closed pilot with bounded zones and monitoring
Require explicit GO before public/live dispatch or payment capture
